data.long_meaning: The name Heppman is derived from the Old German word 'heff' meaning 'to serve' or 'to lift'. This name was used as a surname for someone who managed or served a lord or was a servant in a monastery. The name can be considered a variant of the name Heinrich, which means 'ruler of the home'. The name Heppman carries the meaning “He who manages or serves” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heppman usually hope their child will grow to embody he who manages or serves and live with faith, good character and purpose.
